## Summary

I successfully resolved ticket T-4004. The notification-worker pods were failing to send emails because they were configured with an unqualified hostname (`smtp-relay`) for the SMTP server, but the platform team moved that service to a different namespace (shared-infra) without updating the pods' configuration. The fix is to update the SMTP_HOST environment variable in the notification-worker deployment from `smtp-relay` to `smtp-relay.shared-infra` to use the proper cross-namespace DNS name.
